head: oval countersunk, #6 head, chrome plated (size of GM replacement 9414756)
notes: Direct: camaros.net fastener list (reposted on CorvetteForum) gives 9420554-P153 8-18X1.0. NCRS (Joe Lucia, via NastyZ28): 9420554 discontinued 4/1983, replaced by 9414756 = oval CS phillips tapping screw 8-18 x 1, #6 head, chrome. Drive and head are from the replacement. Used for C3 console shift plate and 63-67 rocker molding ends.

sources.title: 1970 Z28 Screw for Retainer on Shifter Boot | NastyZ28.com
sources.quote: It was discontinued in April, 1983 and I have no other information on it. However, it was replaced at that time by GM #9414756, and I do have information on that screw. It was an oval, countersunk phillips head tapping screw of size 8-18 X 1" . It had a #6 head and was chrome plated.
